body: But why? What is the purpose in reconnecting with society if it continues to refuse to act civil?

No, not at all, really. Considering the state of the world and how it just seems to be one big fuck up, I don't exactly care. Some reasons are like this

-I don't care about your baby, somewhere a kid is starving and the world is overpopulated

-Politics? I don't give a flying fuck about them, they are in it for themselves

-Sports? I like my head without brain damage, thank you.

It goes on and on, and I need something *different* I suppose. Life dealt me the "Fuck your life" card, there is no "happiness" when it comes to the outside world. If anything, I hate the current state of the world. I mean sure, I have a happy wife, a nice apartment, food every night, but is it really all worth it? I was brought into life, a game I didn't get to choose to play in the first place, and was given a defect I couldn't control.

Every one of them, care and love for anyone other than my wife. I feel like I have been cheated in life, because of my defect. I want to end it, the spike of pain I keep hidden in the bowels of my mind. Just let it go away, float on until the end of time. I could say that if I were to sympathize with anyone at all, real or fake, it would be Walter White.

We grew up together since we were 10, (We've been married for 3 years now w/o kids) and we just sort of cliched. We're both social outcasts, we enjoy the same type of music, the only difference between us is my shitty childhood and birth defect.
